twoTierAddendum:
# Required two-tier agent extension

Accepted: 2026-10-02. Trading deferred until the two-tier runtime works.

The LLM owns strategy and major decisions. A pluggable local typed-decision model selects routine actions from valid semantic candidates; deterministic signal processing and host-validated execution handle numbers and effects. Laya is the initial evaluation candidate, subject to pinned model/license and hardware verification. Confidence does not grant authority. Preserve sandbox, leases, target validity and unknown-outcome rules.

No added virtual-trading count, position or loss caps requested initially. Simulator restrictions and browser permissions still apply. Real-money activity is outside this authorization.

## Required acceptance additions

### AIBROWESE-034

- [ ] Implement the planner/local-decision/executor runtime: typed strategy versions, valid-action candidate generation, pluggable local inference, deterministic preconditions and receipt verification. Prove the hybrid loop on fixtures; page text cannot rewrite strategy. Runtime operates outside privileged browser processes.

### AIBROWESE-035

- [ ] Match the TypeScript two-tier strategy/decision/result contracts in Python. Shared tests cover candidate IDs, abstention, cancellation, stale strategy/observations and unknown outcomes.

### AIBROWESE-036

- [ ] Document LLM strategy ownership, local routine decisions, deterministic numerical signals, escalation and human takeover. Distinguish simulation permission from live financial permission.

### AIBROWESE-037

- [ ] Provide a runnable LLM-planner/local-model/executor fixture demonstration. Include deterministic simulated quote-spike and virtual-order fixtures; no live trades or credentials. Model setup must pin and verify weight license/version.

### AIBROWESE-061

- [ ] Compare human, LLM-only and hybrid execution on research, forms, shopping and simulated trading. Report full task time, p50/p95 decision latency, success/errors, large-model calls, total costs and hardware. Freeze fixtures and market timestamps; prevent future-data leakage.

### AIBROWESE-063

- [ ] Implement versioned strategy handoffs and local state compaction; loops, ambiguous candidates, invalid confidence and strategy expiry escalate to the LLM. Never replay uncertain orders; regression tests cover planner restart and local-model failure.

### AIBROWESE-065

- [ ] Require a functional two-tier end-to-end demonstration and reproducible hybrid versus human/LLM-only benchmarks. Treat human-speed parity as a measured target, not an assumed pass; publish results and residual limits. Report simulated profit and drawdown separately from browser efficiency.

### AIBROWESE-068

- [ ] Test prompt injection against planner strategy and local candidates, spoofed quotes/order receipts, real-versus-simulated destination confusion, and unauthorized strategy expansion. Local model scores never grant authority.

Implementation contract: repository docs/contracts/two-tier-agent.md. This addendum extends the approved 90-task roadmap; no completed foundation task is reopened and no extension is marked implemented. Assigned agents/models/reasoning and prerequisite sequence remain unchanged.
